en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a river or mill pond bordered by trees, with a large multi-story brick or stone industrial building (likely a mill) on the right bank. A small dam or weir spans the water in the mid‑background. Two children sit on the grassy bank in the lower right corner, looking toward the water. The scene is rural and tranquil, with forest in the background and clouds in the sky. In the lower left corner there is a photographer's imprint.
